title: is_fips flag single-pass lookup — simpler and race-free
description: The is_fips field on struct crypto2dev_provider drives a module-level atomic counter (fips_provider_count). During lookup, fips_mode is read once under read_lock and applied uniformly to the entire traversal. This is simpler and more correct than a two-pass approach (first collect FIPS providers, then search them) which would require dropping and re-acquiring the lock between passes or a larger critical section. A reviewer might suggest checking p->is_fips inline per-provider rather than reading the counter upfront — that would be equivalent but less clear. The current approach is right: one snapshot, one traversal, no second pass.
